instruction: Add a centered heading "Takeaways" to the second slide of the presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation 7: Center alignment with title 'Takeaways' on slide 2. Verified slide 2 (index 1) exists and currently has empty title. Evaluator checks both alignment (CENTER) and text (Takeaways) with partial credit scoring.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: 0.5 for correct alignment (CENTER), 0.5 for correct text (Takeaways)

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Getter logic flaw - searches for 'first non-empty text shape' (lines 43-47) instead of proper title placeholder. This is incorrect for a task requiring ADDING a heading.
Title shape identification unreliable - should use slide.shapes.title or check placeholder_format.type == PP_PLACEHOLDER_TYPE.TITLE, not first shape with text.
If title is empty before user adds 'Takeaways', the getter will skip it and potentially find a wrong shape (subtitle, content box, etc.).
This logic assumes title already has text, which contradicts the verification scenario where user is adding new text.
Getter may read wrong shape if other non-empty text shapes exist on the slide before the title placeholder in shapes collection.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Replace lines 43-47 with proper title detection: Use slide.shapes.title to get the title placeholder directly.
If slide.shapes.title is None, check shapes for placeholder_format.type == PP_PLACEHOLDER_TYPE.TITLE (import from pptx.enum.shapes).
Remove the 'if hasattr(shape, 'text') and shape.text.strip()' condition that skips empty shapes - titles can be empty before user adds text.
Handle case where title placeholder exists but is empty (this is expected for this task).
